decisions.label: Triple-Negative Breast Carcinoma
decisions.description: An invasive breast carcinoma that is negative for expression of estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), and human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2).

verification.note: NCIT:C71732 Triple-Negative Breast Carcinoma; label abbreviation TNBC matches this exact term.

decisions.label: Luminal A Breast Carcinoma
decisions.description: A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by high expression of genes characteristic of luminal epithelial cells, including estrogen receptor (ER). This subtype is associated with a good prognosis.

verification.note: NCIT:C53554 Luminal A Breast Carcinoma; LumA is the standard abbreviation for this subtype.

decisions.label: Luminal B Breast Carcinoma
decisions.description: A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by low to moderate expression of genes characteristic of luminal epithelial cells including estrogen receptor (ER), and high expression of GGH, LAPTM4B, and CCNE1.

verification.note: NCIT:C53555 Luminal B Breast Carcinoma; LumB is the standard abbreviation.

decisions.label: HER2-Positive Breast Carcinoma
decisions.description: A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by high expression of HER2, GRB7, and TRAP100, and by lack of expression of estrogen receptor (ER).

verification.note: NCIT:C53556 HER2-Positive Breast Carcinoma; HER2 abbreviation maps directly to this subtype.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier.
